name: How long does a typical window installation project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical window installation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a window installation project varies depending on several factors, including the number of windows, their size and type, and the complexity of the installation. For a standard residential project involving 5-10 windows, installation can typically be completed within one to three days. Larger or more custom projects may require additional time. We provide a detailed timeline during the initial consultation, ensuring you are fully informed about the schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical window installation for 5-10 windows usually takes 1-3 days, depending on project size and complexity.
